title: Every module is a quotient of a flat module, indeed of a direct sum of sheaves pushed forward from opens
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every module is a quotient of a direct sum of modules extended by zero from opens, and hence a quotient of a flat module (author lemma at source lines 2855-2864, label lemma-module-quotient-flat). The proof (source lines 2866-2880) builds one map from the module extended by zero on an open into the given module for every section over that open by adjunction, observes that the direct sum of all of them is surjective, and concludes flatness of the source from the flatness of the extended modules and of direct sums (proof lines 2868-2879). The adjunction construction and the flatness check are the content. H2.
